info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to go, to move, to kill, to be angry, to cause pain

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: jAnA, calanA,mAranA, duHKa denA, kroDa karanA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: asya sew-tvam iti tattvaboDinIkA kAramatam iti jYAyate . nyAsakArAdayaH aniw tvaM manyate . vistarastu kfdantarUpamAlAyAM drazwavyaH . rezaRaM = hiMsA . ' gatirozaRayoH ' iti kutracit dfzwaH pAWaH . rezaRaSabdasya vfkaSabdArTattvAt kvacideva neyamiti puruzakAraH . ' ravate rOti Sabdane ' (Slo. 23) iti devaH .
